descriptions.counterfactual: A wheel with a visible fixed off-centre metal weight is released from rest on a gentle incline. The wheel initially rolls uphill while its combined centre of mass descends. Without a drive, it continues uphill beyond its passive turning range, raising its combined centre of mass above its release height.
descriptions.true: A wheel with a visible fixed off-centre metal weight is released from rest on a gentle incline. The wheel initially rolls uphill while its combined centre of mass descends. It reaches a turning point and rolls back toward a lower-energy position.

generation.motion_authority: One-DOF rigid no-slip rolling with a fixed eccentric ballast, exact mass moment and positive damping. Gravitational potential uses the combined centre of mass, not axle height. CF adds one unpowered torque controller after a geometry-derived event. Wheel and ballast remain a single rigid assembly; input work is zero in True. Blender renders stored integrated states.
